meta.title: Open API for developers
meta.description: YukSaroy read-only open API: active listings, terminals, facets and ontology. No key, JSON, 120 requests per minute.

developers.title: Open API for developers
developers.lead: Active listings, terminals, counts and the code dictionary are available with plain GET requests. No key and no login: plug it into your system, bot or spreadsheet.

rules.get: GET only, JSON responses (UTF-8). Money in tiyin (integer), dates in ISO 8601.
rules.active: Active objects only: ACTIVE listings, open terminals. Phone numbers and other contact data are never returned.
rules.limit: Over the limit you get 429 with code {code}; pace requests by the headers.
rules.version: Fields are never removed or renamed; new fields may appear. Breaking changes ship as a new version.

listings.desc: Active equipment and road transport listings: title, region, price and unit, condition, organisation name and KYC badge. Paginated: items, total, page, limit.
listings.params: kind (comma-separated: SHUNTING_LOCO, ELECTRIC_LOCO, WAGON, TRUCK), region (comma-separated: UZ-TK, UZ-SA ...), page, limit (1 to 50)

terminals.desc: Open terminals: name, station, kind, services, tariffs, free slots today. Paginated: items, total, page, limit.
terminals.params: region (comma-separated), kind (YARD, CONTAINER, LC, SVX), service (comma-separated, all required: LOAD, UNLOAD, WEIGH, STORAGE, SVX, CONTAINER, LAST_MILE, SHUNTING), page, limit (1 to 50)

facets.desc: Counts: terminals by kind, region and service; listings by kind, region and deal. Every code is present, even with zero.

ontology.desc: Code dictionary in three languages: regions, services, terminal and listing kinds, deal, condition, wagon and truck body types, price units, organisation kinds.

changelog.desc: Version history: version, date, notes in three languages.

example.unavailable: No live example yet: the API did not respond. The page retries in 60 seconds.
example.truncated: truncated, full response in the request

ontology.heading: Ontology
ontology.lead: Every code has a label in three languages. Filters and responses use only these codes: load the dictionary once and map it to your own codes.

changelog.heading: Changelog
changelog.unavailable: History comes from the API; no response right now. Current contract: {version}.

terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.attribution: When you show the data, credit the source: "YukSaroy data" with a link to yuksaroy.uz.
terms.resale: No reselling the database, redistributing dumps or copying into a competing catalogue. Showing it inside your own product is fine.
terms.contact: The API carries no contact data; reach owners only through the YukSaroy page. The page link is in each card (slug).
terms.limit: Stay under {n} requests per minute; cache. Need more: write to us and we will set a separate limit.
terms.guarantee: No uptime guarantee; important changes are announced in the history on this page.

cta.body: A question, or need a higher limit? Write on Telegram: replies within a working day.
